description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the tab and returns the result as JSON. Escape hatch only when other tools can't do it. Runs in an isolated world by default: DOM can be read and modified, but globals created by page scripts (window.appVar, etc.) are not visible, and the page cannot see this code. world="page" runs it in the page's own world instead (page variables and functions are usable; top document only). The page can then observe what the code does (it goes through any functions the site has wrapped), so use it only when page variables/functions are really needed or the user asks.

agent.description: Your display name, shown to other agents. Subagents must always set it. Default "claude-5f2c".

multiSlot.description: true only when one agent must handle several slots together (e.g. comparing). Normally omit (one agent = one slot; use subagents for the rest)

slot.description: Browser slot 1-99. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

summary.description: One-line note of what you are doing (e.g. "comparing laptop prices"). Shown in browser_status (not the status line). Omit to keep the previous one.

tab.description: Target tab: number (1, 2…) or ID ("t7"). Use the stable ID when agents share a slot. Required for action tools when there are multiple tabs.

timeout.description: Max seconds to wait for the result (default 30). Raise it for long jobs (bulk collection, many requests) instead of re-running

world.description: isolated (default): separate from page scripts. page: the page's own world, to use variables/functions the site defined

name: browser_eval
title: Run JS
